title: trio SDKs: introduce auth-proxy + stream-iterator adapter and coordinated version bumps
author: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: each SDK implemented auth refresh, streaming iterators and telemetry tagging slightly differently which caused subtle disconnects in token handoff and inconsistent backoff behavior. This PR centralizes an "auth-proxy" shim pattern, introduces a small stream-iterator adapter for ergonomic async/iter consumers, and coordinates minor version bumps across Python/TS/Go SDK packages.

What this PR delivers (summary): single-line auth proxy (opt-in) for managed token wrapping, unified retry/backoff hints surfaced to application layer, a StreamIteratorAdapter that exposes a consistent async pull API across SDKs, lightweight telemetry tag propagation for session/stream spans, and package.json/go.mod/pyproject.toml updates for v1.11.x bumps.

Why now: customer incidents highlighted a race during token rotation under sustained streaming load; SDK teams agreed on a minimal stable surface that avoids breaking consumers while improving parity.

Compatibility and migration: auth-proxy is opt-in. Existing users are unaffected until they switch to the new constructor arg (credential_proxy=True / CredentialProxy()). StreamIteratorAdapter is additive; older iterator APIs remain. Releases include short migration notes for each SDK in their changelogs.

Checklist:
- [x] design review with SDK leads (ENG-3182)
- [x] prototype + perf microbenchmarks
- [x] unit + integration tests across languages
- [x] coordinated package releases and docs updates

This description intentionally keeps implementation details high-level; see commits and changed files for specifics.

Sofia Ortega: Tests look good; please add a small perf regression guard to ensure adapter doesn't add >2% CPU under 1000 concurrent streams.
Maya Chen (author): Added microbench in sdk/python/bench/stream_bench.py and a configured CI perf-check that runs on release branch. Local results show ~0.8% median CPU delta.

Liam Novak: Minor nit: documentation should include example migrations for back-compat; link to docs/sdk-migration/stream-auth-proxy.md added. Approving contingent on changelog entries in each SDK package.
Maya Chen (author): Changelogs updated and package manifests bumped.
release_notes: Adds an opt-in auth proxy shim and a StreamIteratorAdapter across Python/TS/Go SDKs to improve token rotation safety and unify streaming ergonomics. Minor SDK version bumps: Python v1.11.2, TypeScript v1.11.1, Go v1.11.0. No breaking changes by default (opt-in).
